About

Independent IT expertise from Frankfurt am Main.

EMETRIX Tech brings cybersecurity, IT operations and web development together into one well-designed whole, for companies that take their digital infrastructure seriously.

Why EMETRIX Tech exists

Many companies face the same problem: their IT grew over years, responsibilities are scattered, and nobody has the full picture. At the same time, the demands keep rising, from cyberattacks, from regulation like NIS2 and GDPR, and from customers who ask for proof of security.

EMETRIX Tech was founded to solve exactly this, with technical depth, a structured method and the ability to explain complex topics clearly. We do not see security, operations and development as separate. We see one connected system.

Our standard: every recommendation is justified, every measure documented, every invoice traceable.

What we stand for

Confidentiality

Your data and the findings from our reviews stay with you. We work under NDA on request.

Independence

No vendor ties, no commissions. Our recommendations follow your needs alone.

Thoroughness

We work to recognised standards and document so that results can be verified.

Partnership

We explain instead of complicating, and enable your team to practise security every day.
